title: StellarHunts Puzzle Template
description: Standardized schema for StellarHunts puzzle content, enabling authors to contribute puzzles without modifying game engine or contract code.

version.description: Schema version of the puzzle template.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID or kebab-case slug) for the puzzle.

title.description: Short, descriptive title of the puzzle.

description.description: High-level overview and storyline/context for the challenge.

difficulty.description: Difficulty tier corresponding to game progression and badge tiers.

type.description: Answer input and validation type for the puzzle.

prompt.description: The primary question or puzzle prompt presented to the user.

options.description: Options list required for multiple_choice puzzle types.

initialCode.description: Starter code snippet for code-type puzzles.

language.description: Programming or scripting language for code puzzles.

imageUrl.description: URL to an image asset for image/cryptogram puzzles.

solution.description: The expected answer, plaintext solution, or cryptographic hash.

solutionType.description: Method used to evaluate the submitted answer against the solution.

hint.description: Optional hint to assist stuck players.

rewardId.description: Associated backend reward identifier or UUID.

type.description: Type of reward issued upon puzzle completion.

metadata.description: Custom metadata such as badge rarity, image URL, or points amount.

author.description: Author name, GitHub handle, or Stellar public key of the creator.

tags.description: Searchable topic tags (e.g. soroban, cryptography, stellar-basics).

isActive.description: Whether the puzzle is actively available to players.
